about: Judge 6's removal list (its review.json, made after the held-out run at 47a5c76), applied in full: high, medium and low severity alike. Since round 7 the site shows verses only after a visitor taps a topic, and a visitor in any state can tap any topic, so no theme can be gated. Therefore every high-severity item is removed from the pool entirely, even where the judge named only some of its themes (for Joshua 1:9 the judge offered to keep it under fear_anxiety only 'if courage cannot be gated'; it cannot, and 'whithersoever thou goest' reads the same under any label). A medium or low item that names only some of the verse's themes loses just those themes; one that names all of them is removed.
